definition: exaggerated or uncontrollable emotion or excitement
hook: We call a panic hysteria without blinking. The word points a finger at one organ.
modernAnchor: Mass hysteria. Don't get hysterical. We use it for emotion that has slipped its leash entirely.
journey: Ancient Greek physicians had a theory. They believed the womb could wander loose inside the body.
A roaming womb, they claimed, pressed on other organs and drove a woman to wild emotion.
From hystera, the Greek for womb, they built a diagnosis reserved almost entirely for women.
The medicine was nonsense. The word survived, and we still aim it mostly at women losing control.
